job: Re-architecting model loading and KV-cache management to match vLLM's quantized-by-default plus tiered KV-offload baseline so they don't cede throughput-per-dollar.
outcome: A released engine version where quantized model loading and tiered KV-cache offload are documented out-of-the-box defaults, not opt-in tuning.
motivation: Competitive parity: shipping FP16-by-default and full-precision-only KV would surrender measurable throughput-per-dollar to vLLM.

task.what: Make quantized loading and tiered KV-offload the default
task.why: Keep cost parity with vLLM's serving-layer gains
task.how: Low-precision FP8 kernels plus object-store secondary KV tier

job: Folding the new engine defaults into hosted serving tiers so customer endpoints inherit quantized loading and tiered KV-cache spill automatically.
outcome: Hosted inference tiers that ship quantized-by-default loading and tiered KV offload as the platform default configuration.
motivation: Serving-layer cost gains drive margin and price competitiveness for managed offerings in 2026.

task.what: Adopt upstream quantized + KV-offload defaults into hosted tiers
task.where: Hosted inference control plane and endpoint defaults
task.when: After upstream engines ship, through H1 2027
